senses.zh_definition: Teresa：人名，常见于女性姓名，可音译为“特蕾莎”；此处仅按专有名词暂列，未核实小写 teresa 有独立的马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: Teresa, a personal name commonly used for women; no independent Malay common-word sense is verified here.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, lazimnya nama perempuan, yang ditulis Teresa; takrif ini ialah keterangan nama, bukan takrif kata umum yang disahkan daripada Kamus Dewan.
senses.nuances: 输入包没有 DBP 释义、音节、IPA 或爪夷文，不能据此标为已核实的 official 词条。官方材料可证实 Teresa 用于姓名，但不能证实小写 teresa 是普通词。以下搭配只是姓名使用示例，不宣称为高频词汇搭配；例句中的人物均为虚构。[姓名用例：DBP eBorneo](https://eborneo.dbp.gov.my/hubungi.html)。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Dia tunggu kat dalam je. Jom masuk.

etymology.historical_story: Teresa appears in Malaysian official material as part of personal names, including the name Teresa Chong on a DBP editorial page. That establishes local use of a name, not a Malay common noun. The supplied packet provides no lexical definition or pronunciation. A specific ancient derivation, standardized Jawi spelling, or ordinary Malay meaning therefore cannot responsibly be supplied here. [姓名用例：DBP eBorneo](https://eborneo.dbp.gov.my/hubungi.html)。
